overview_description.description: ADAM is a high–end contemporary clothing business with wholesale, retail and e–Commerce outlets. ADAM manufactures and sells contemporary sportswear lines for men and women at luxury retailers such as Bergdorf Goodman, Neiman Marcus and Harrod’s, at ADAM retail stores, and through ShopADAM.com. ADAM produces a year–round Basics line and seasonal offerings (Spring, Summer, Fall, Holiday and Resort).
